purpose: First end-to-end MODEL-2 training smoke — validates dispatch + convergence-curve shape. NOT a full convergence run to SHIP-013 ≤ 2.2 floor.

ship_013_gap_analysis.status: NOT_DISCHARGED — training descended 0.50 nats in 1300 steps but stalled on plateau; need (a) more steps, (b) hyperparameter tuning (LR schedule, batch size), (c) larger corpus, or some combination to cross the 2.2 floor. Algorithm-level verdict_from_val_ce_loss binding remains correct; runtime evidence falls short of the target.

infrastructure_outcome.assessment: Phase 3 training infrastructure is fully proven: dispatch wiring (v2.46), step-budget (v2.47), per-step JSON (v2.47), --version --json (v2.48), and now end-to-end 1300-step live training with EARLY_STOP guard, clean exit, and val-loss descent signal. What remains for SHIP-013 is NOT an infrastructure gap — it's a training/tuning gap.

next_actions: Longer run: multi-hour --num-steps 50000+ to exit the early plateau region
Larger batch: once GPU memory headroom confirmed (current 22.2 GB / 24 GB at b=1 seq=2048 — maybe batch=2 possible)
Corpus size: CSN-Python-2048 may be too small for 370M — check val loss on a larger held-out split
